The '''1992–93 season''' was the 62nd season for '''[[Real Madrid C.F.]]''' in La Liga.

==Summary==
{{Unreferenced section|date=August 2026}}
Real Madrid once again failed to win the La Liga despite taking the lead in late May thanks to [[Barcelona]]'s several slips in the league. However, they once again collapsed in the season finale against [[CD Tenerife|Tenerife]] for the second season in a row.

After failing to win the league, Real Madrid once again settled for [[Copa del Rey]] as a consolation prize by defeating [[Real Zaragoza]] 2–0 against in late June. On the other hand, Real Madrid also went out of the [[1992–93 UEFA Cup|UEFA Cup]] against [[Paris-Saint Germain]] in the quarter-finals.
